verdict.rationale: LanceDB is a database, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack shows no official MCP server. The 'LanceDB plugin' for AI coding agents is never described as an MCP server, and the branching guides for agent experiments are adjacent features, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
